actions: Deploy NAS sequence number validation with a rolling window of 3.
Enforce NAS-EPS sequence number < 1000 for all NAS messages.
Enable EEA4 ciphering integrity checks via NAS-EPS EMM.
Implement NAS message rate limiting at 5 messages/second per UE.
Deploy NAS message size validation (< 256 bytes).
Enable NAS message replay detection with a 10-second window.
Configure RAN to drop NAS messages with nested_field1_unmaskedvalue > 128.
Enforce NAS-EPS EEA4 ciphering enforcement for all UEs.
Update core network to reject NAS messages with emm_eea4_show > 100.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
